name: clarityai
description: Improves developer prompts by fixing grammar, spelling, and clarity before sending to Copilot
author: Ahmed Attafi

chatParticipants.name: clarity
chatParticipants.description: Intelligently chooses fast or thinking mode based on prompt complexity

commands.name: architect
commands.description: Enhance prompt with focus on scalability, design patterns, and architecture

commands.name: security
commands.description: Enhance prompt with focus on OWASP, sanitization, and vulnerability prevention

commands.name: reviewer
commands.description: Deeply review and critique the logic of your prompt like a Senior Lead

commands.name: tester
commands.description: Focus on test coverage, edge cases, and quality assurance strategy

commands.name: documentation
commands.description: Focus on JSDoc, READMEs, and technical explanations

commands.name: performance
commands.description: Focus on runtime efficiency, memory management, and optimization

commands.name: frontend
commands.description: Focus on UI/UX, accessibility (A11y), and responsive design

commands.name: vault
commands.description: List and recall your saved enhanced prompts

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show the ClarityAI command guide and feature overview

chatParticipants.name: clarity-fast
chatParticipants.description: Uses fastest LLM for quick prompt improvements

chatParticipants.name: clarity-thinking
chatParticipants.description: Uses ClarityAI's advanced reasoning mode for complex prompts

clarity.autoInjectContext.description: Automatically inject project context (framework, dependencies, current file) into prompts

clarity.showDiffView.description: Show detailed comparison between original and enhanced prompts

clarity.enableMermaid.description: Automatically generate architectural Mermaid.js diagrams for complex requests

clarity.showEducationalInsights.description: Show 'Key Additions (Why They Matter)' section in the comparison view

clarity.defaultPersona.description: Sets a default expert persona to use for all prompt enhancements when no subcommand is used
